reviews.text: They say all dogs go to heaven, well Canine State of Mind is as close to heaven on earth that I have ever seen! Sasha has created a sanctuary for dogs that provides exactly what they need to succeed, I believe she has over 600 acres of land! Her knowledge of dogs is second to none and I wouldn’t want to send my animals anywhere else. I first heard of Sasha on the Paul Check podcast where I was immediately drawn to her which led me to reading her book, Peaceful Dog Mastery. So much powerful information! I couldn’t be more pleased with Sasha, and I am forever grateful for what she did for my dogs and me.

Sasha and her team at CSOM  have been such a blessing to our family. We found her about nine years ago with our dog Bernie, who runs to get in the van for his vacations at the farm.  It gives us such peace of mind to know he is receiving the highest quality care while we are away. We recently added a new puppy to the family and Sasha has been incredibly helpful during our education sessions, educating us on why our older dog was behaving differently and puppy behaviors as well. She understands dogs on a deeper level than most dog trainers and has a profound respect for them as well. Our puppy went to board with her for two weeks recently and came back with so much confidence and such an improvement in our two dogs relationship with one another. I highly recommend Sasha and Canine State of Mind to anyone seeking the best advice and care for their dog.

We have used Canine State of Mind for many years now for our sighthounds. I never worry about our dogs when we leave them with Sasha as I know that Sasha and her team will take excellent care of them and make the best decisions available if need arises. Both of our dogs have benefitted greatly from their stays at Canine State of Mind. Our old unneutered show dog loved being able to play in a pack while boarding. Our younger dog suffers from separation anxiety, but stays with Sasha have built his confidence all around and he now whines eagerly to jump into her car when she picks him up. Our dogs have always returned to us relaxed and calm having enjoyed a great vacation in a healthy (and healthy minded) setting in the country.

I brought a 6 month old Australian cattle dog to canine state of mind. Lauren had been neglected by the backyard breeder and was completely shut down indoors, and outdoors could not walk on a leash. She was a fearful and unhappy pup. After 6 weeks with Sasha, Lauren now enjoys being inside with other dogs and can walk on a leash. She has been home for 2 weeks now, and she has a sassy personality. There are still some hurdles for her to cross, but that will come with time. Every few days, Lauren gains a little more confidence in her new surroundings and that's a beautiful thing to see, thanks to Sasha at canine state of mind.

We highly recommend Canine State of Mind (CSOM) for both reference and assistance with your dogs.
Sasha Armstrong who owns and coordinates all parts of the facility, is knowledgeable and compassionate. She shares a connection with and offers compassion for all dogs, especially those entrusted to her for overnight stays.
Dog owners and their dogs can benefit from insight she offers through on line courses or live conversation.
Lastly, our dogs have returned from their stays at CSOM facility happy and healthy, something I cannot say about other facilities we used prior to discovering CSOM.
We, and our dogs, highly recommend CSOM!!

Thank you to Sasha and Canine State of Mind for taking such good care of our GSP, Millie. We know Millie is in good hands when she is with CSM—from the time Sasha picks her up to the time she returns her. I rest easy knowing Millie has room to run and play during the day and a safe, comfortable environment at night. In addition, Sasha’s commitment to helping pet owners make the most of their relationship with their dogs speaks to her celebration of all the canines she works with and cares for. My family highly recommends Canine State of Mind.

If you are in need of a dog behaviorist for coaching for your dog (and YOURSELF), I urge you to seek out Sasha Armstrong at Canine State of Mind. In my opinion, Sasha is hands down the best Dog Behaviorist in the world. I work with animals everyday, and I have never met anyone more intuitive with animals than Sasha. I've seen it with my own Old English Sheepdog, and I've been able to recommend a number of my clients to Sasha for expert help with their pets. Sasha's methods are not cookie cutter methods used by other "trainers". Her methods are, innovative, tried and true, and you will not be disappointed by the results!
We have been sending our dog to Sasha for 5+ years and wouldn’t trust anyone more. Sasha has a way with animals like no other. Would highly recommend !
Our dog LOVES going there!

I've had the pleasure of working with Sasha over the past few years.  From the moment we started, it was clear that she had a deep understanding of canine behavior.  She provided personalized strategies that made a noticeable difference to me and my dog, Coco.  Sasha is patient, encouraging and focused.  She explained the rationale behind her technique and how it would strengthen my connection with Coco.  As a result, Coco and I have a deeper bond through trust, understanding and awareness in our daily interactions. The progress we made together was impressive and continues to grow.  I highly recommend this experience!

Sasha at Canine State of Mind has been a superior coach in helping us to understand our puppies language. She has a deep understanding of dog psychology. She has been with us since we got nugget at two months old. Sasha has assisted us in creating a peaceful confident and independent puppy. Sasha gently and patiently guided us in a whole new thought process regarding raising a dog that is amazing and effective. We highly recommend Sasha and Canine State of Mind for anyone looking for a more compassionate, respectful and mindful way to raise your puppy or dog. This program is not for Training your dog, but to help develop you be a strong leader and the alpha your dog needs you to be. We believe Sasha was sent to us divinely and greatly appreciate her always being there for us. We very much enjoyed and appreciated her passion for dogs.

“  I have been working in a 1:1 container with Sasha with my new puppy, Frodo for the past several months. Sasha  has guided me through this critical developmental time.
This has been a very enlightening and enriching experience for myself and my dog. Her approach is unique and energy centered. Learning the way of the Alpha will challenge you and deepen your connection with your dog and yourself.
Allowing my dog to be a dog and understanding his behaviors, instincts and needs has been key!
Sasha has made herself available to answer all my questions and problem solve when necessary with effective solutions that work.
Her Masterclass is also an amazing tool/resource, informative and delivered in small clear chunks makes it easily digestible. To reinforce and layer my learning I have read her book and done the Masterclass along with 1:1 work.  Also  note that there is lot’s of greatest info on Canine state of minds philosophy and tip on her social media.
I am loving this journey with my pup and value how we are growing together. Thankful for both Sasha and my pup as MY teachers. 🐺🐺🐺💗🙏
Brenda

We’ve been working with Canine State of Mind over the past year through private training and boarding for our 18-month-old Airedale Terrier and have been pleased with the results and support we’ve received from Sasha.

We had sent our puppy to another board and train facility, focused on negative reinforcement, and have found that Sasha’s training methods are much more effective and long-lasting. Sasha has an innate understanding of canine behavior and not only taught us how to train our dog, but also how we as owners should interact with our dog to build a healthy relationship. Sasha was there every step of the way, hopping on the phone to answer our questions between sessions and communicating frequently to check in. If you’re looking for obedience, standard training or basic commands, her methods may not be for you but if you’re willing to put in the time and effort the results are well worth it. The transformation of our dog since day one has been significant - she is happier, more relaxed and better behaved - and we can’t thank Sasha enough!

We’ve also had a great experience with boarding our dog and the pick up/drop off options are really convenient. We feel at ease knowing she is under Sasha’s care and able to have the space to run around at her beautiful farm while we’re out of town. We’d love to be able to receive more updates and pictures while she’s there but would recommend Canine State of Mind as an option for longer term boarding (1 week+) stays.
learning cutting edge ways of partnering with my dog both mentally and physically!

For compassionate and honest dog training and boarding, look no further than Sasha and her team. She helped our dog work through his issues that others could not, and we're so happy to have worked with her.
I have been a customer of Sasha’s for several years for boarding for my dog. I always know that my dog is receiving the best care while I am away, and he is always happy to return for his stays.

It is a rare and precious gift to find Sasha. She is so deeply dedicated to the health and well being of dogs, every dog. Not only dogs but their relationship with their “people” is something Sasha passionately cares deeply about. With great kindness Shasha helps to ease where the struggles are and bring both the dog and its person into a harmonious understanding and interaction.  I am enormously grateful for Sasha. She is an Angel who knows the deep and ancient Spirit every dog carries within, and the gift they bring their human companions.  She helps us to free them from any misconceptions we carry, so we may experience the pleasure of their authenticity, their true and beautiful way of being.  Thank you Sasha, you bring beauty into our walk in life, with our canine companions.
Professional owner and staff,  my dog Togo loves going here.  Clean and well laid out facility.  I'm so happy we have a place like this that cares for our dogs well-being.

I am incredibly disappointed and upset by our experience with Canine State of Mind. I thought this was going to be a game changer for our corgi with anxiety issues; the entire experience was something out of a nightmare.

We paid $5,500 for the two week board and train; to start, our friends who dropped off our pup while we were on our honeymoon said that Sasha was an hour late to the pick up spot.

We received no updates during those two weeks while he was there other than that he was "settled in beautifully"; I offered to send over instructions for his food we sent with him, which she said was not needed.

We had a training session with Sasha the day before our dog returned to us, where her instructions were to ignore our dog and not engage with him at all directly. No eye contact, no petting, don't talk to him, basically act like he doesn't exist, besides fulfilling his basic needs. She did not give any real instruction besides ignoring him and having "calm and strong" energy.

My husband picks up our dog the next day, and we were horrified with what we saw. Our dog's butt was caked in old, dried diarrhea. His bed was incredibly dirty and smelled so bad he had to plug his nose on the way home.

His bag we sent with him was completely shredded up inside, with his toys destroyed, and all of his food and treats gone, despite sending an excess with him. Our dog has NEVER in his life destroyed a toy, furniture, etc., so we know this was done by another dog at the farm.

The bag was also filled to the brim with a HUGE pile of gray dog hair that was clearly not our dog's??? (our dog is white and brown).

We completely ignored our dog, per her instructions. He mostly acted as he normally does. Sasha would occasionally send voice notes reiterating how we should not engage with him, and how we should try to reduce any anxious energy.

He continued to have liquid diarrhea for the next couple of weeks, as well as throw up bile several times. Sasha said that it was strange, as he "didn't have diahhrea during his stay". Really? The old caked on poop all over his butt and bed when we picked him up says otherwise. She said they "wash bedding every other day" and she "never noticed poop on his behind".  The poop on him was OLD and caked on; it was not fresh. His bed absolutely REEKED; I cannot imagine it was washed at all, never mind every other day. Her recommendation on his new GI issues was "I wouldn't rush to the vet".

She said that her instruction for how to directly engage with him would come with time, but over a week passed, and she was still having us avoid any contact with our dog. I'm sorry, but I'm not going to not make ANY contact with my dog for over a week. If there's certain ways I need to change how I interact with him, fine, but telling me not to interact with him at all is not real dog training.

After three weeks have passed, our dog's GI issues are finally resolving, and we have ignored Sasha's last two texts to inquire how he is doing. I cannot trust her anymore after the blatant lying  and gaslighting about his condition upon as return, as well as the lazy "training" method of ignoring our dog instead of addressing his issues.

Sasha told us that dogs need much LESS than their owners think they do - that is evident from how she cared for our dog. I am horrified to think of what he experienced while he was at the farm, and we will never know, because it is evident that we cannot trust Sasha, and we have no photo or video evidence that they fulfill ANY of the promises they make on their website. I am deeply regretful that we sent our dog to Canine State of Mind, and am surprised there aren't more reviews like mine online.

Sasha is an incredible woman with such passion for animals! We sent our toy poodle to her behavioral classes and he came home a much more peaceful and relaxed dog. Her one on one training with us helped us understand how and why dogs behave in certain ways and gave us the tools to continue working with him at home.  We will always be grateful for her and her patience and love for our dog!

We own a Great Pyrenees mix in a condo in the city. Should he be on a farm guarding livestock? Of course he should, but seemingly that is not his journey. He's a big pup who has been a bit misunderstood (even by us as we'd never owned a dog like him) and a little unpredictable (eg. he's bitten people). We worked with Sasha on how to better understand him and his behaviors, and it's helped. And when we travel, he goes out to her farm to stay, where we know he's happy and well cared for. Thank you, Sasha, for loving him, and giving us some freedom over the past five years.

Any other boarding experience makes our dog very anxious, but with Sasha’s crew she is so excited to jump in the van and head to the farm!
